title: TYR-0 mission plan
description: One signed plan per pass (CONTRACT.md v0.6 §5.1, §5.2, §5.5, §16.2). A plan is a YAML file in plans/; this schema checks it once parsed. Its signature is a separate file. Signature verification, a chain's spans meeting end to start, and the plan matching its scenario are BALDUR-0's checks (§5.3). The plan admits no field §5.1 does not list, so no field can condition or limit the protective commands (§5.5). In YAML, quote ON and OFF: unquoted, YAML reads them as true and false.

plan_version.description: Raised on any change; a changed plan is re-signed.

pass_index.description: Which pass of the run, counting from 1.

valid_from_met_s.description: The plan is in force only inside this span.

valid_until_met_s.description: The plan is in force only inside this span.

contact_window.description: This pass's contact, from HUGINN's pinned orbit and station.

objectives.description: What the pass is for, in plain language. Text only; nothing evaluates it.

prohibited.description: Commands ODIN may never send under this plan, at any rung. Never CMD_SAFE_ENTER or CMD_SYS_RESET (§5.5).

envelope.description: Limits that must hold on current telemetry. While any does not hold, every command except a C3 PROTECT command counts as C4 (§7.4).

leases.description: Pre-authorized C4 commands and their conditions (§5.2). Two leases may not name the same command with overlapping allowed arguments: a value of state or target in both lists, or rate ranges that meet. JSON Schema cannot compare them, so plan verification refuses such a plan as SCHEMA_VIOLATION, naming both leases (the Director's ruling on U27, 27 October 2026).

references.description: The frozen COSMOS reference and any other frozen input.

lease.description: Pre-authorizes one C4 command for the whole plan; ODIN does not open or close it (§5.2). A lease may not name CMD_SAFE_ENTER or CMD_SYS_RESET (§5.5).

arguments.description: The allowed values of every argument of the leased command (§16.2 U9): a list for state and target, an inclusive {min, max} for rate. An empty object is invalid, since every command a lease may name takes one argument.

conditions.description: Each must hold on telemetry no older than 10 seconds of simulation time, when the command is checked and again just before dispatch. Empty means none.

max_uses.description: Uses allowed during the whole plan, counted once and never reset. Null means unlimited.

rate_range.description: The rates a lease allows, inclusive, inside 0.1 to 10.0 Hz (§16.2 U9). JSON Schema cannot compare min with max, so a range with min above max is not caught here.

version.description: As written on the procedure (§16.2 U10). In YAML, quote a version such as "1" or "1.0", or YAML reads it as a number.
